records.description: req.protocol returns '' (req.secure false) for a trusted X-Forwarded-Proto with an empty leading comma-separated element
records.reachability_analysis: no guard; the index!==-1 branch (request.js:312-313) is reached unconditionally once trust passes and the header contains a comma — no non-empty-token check or fallback-to-proto when the first element is empty. req.protocol is a public getter read by req.secure and HTTPS-gating middleware.

records.description: res.cookie with sub-second maxAge serializes Max-Age=0 alongside a future Expires, dropping the cookie on Max-Age-preferring UAs
records.reachability_analysis: no guard; Math.floor(maxAge/1000) (response.js:764) is reached unconditionally inside if(!isNaN(maxAge)) for any numeric maxAge; no minimum, round-up, or Max-Age/Expires reconciliation. Hit by any 0<maxAge<1000 (e.g. 500ms flash/CSRF cookie).

records.description: res.redirect emits the literal 'undefined' in body and <title> for an in-range status absent from statuses.message (e.g. 310)
records.reachability_analysis: no guard; res.status (response.js:70) admits any integer 100-999, a strictly larger set than statuses.message covers, and the redirect body builder (:841,:846-847) reads statuses.message[status] with no fallback. Reached for any in-range code the message map omits.

records.consolidation_rationale: all three cells trace to one divergence — string-send overwrites charset to utf-8 via setCharset while Buffer-send and res.set only add a charset when absent (mime.contentType); a single uniform charset rule across the three surfaces closes all three cells.
records.description: Charset asymmetry: res.send forces charset=utf-8 for string bodies but preserves the caller's charset for Buffer bodies and via res.set
records.reachability_analysis: no guard; the string branch (response.js:140) and Buffer branch (:150-153) are mutually exclusive arms of the same switch(typeof chunk) and each is reached unconditionally for its body type whenever a Content-Type with a charset is pre-set; no reconciliation before headers flush.

records.description: acceptParams splits quoted parameter values on an inner ';' and does not clamp q to [0,1]
records.reachability_analysis: no guard; the boundary scan (utils.js:96-108) uses str.indexOf('='/';' ) with zero quoted-string awareness and :111 assigns parseFloat(value) with no clamp; reached unconditionally via normalizeType (utils.js:61-64) for any Accept/res.format/res.type media-type string with a quoted ';' or out-of-range q. Executable RED->GREEN confirmed in isolation: buggy params.x='"a', q=5; fixed params.x='a;b', q=1.

records.consolidation_rationale: all three cells trace to one root defect at host — substring(0, indexOf(',')) selects the empty leading element. hostname and subdomains are strict downstream consumers, so a single fix at the host getter closes all three cells.
records.description: req.host/req.hostname/req.subdomains resolve to undefined/[] for a trusted X-Forwarded-Host with a leading comma
records.reachability_analysis: no guard; the trusted-branch split (request.js:424-427) is reached unconditionally when trust passes and XFH contains a comma, and always takes substring(0, firstComma) — '' when the first comma is at index 0. No non-empty-authority selection. Reached for any trusted comma-led XFH value.
